readerCopy.body: The old obligation may have become a rule nobody has reconsidered. Saturn square the South Node can expose a responsibility, hierarchy, deadline, or standard that keeps repeating because everyone assumes you will continue to carry it. You may feel guilty changing the arrangement because you have been reliable for so long. The pressure is information. A commitment can have history and still need new terms. Do not confuse endurance with consent.
